items.title: What to expect as Russia, Ukraine and the US hold trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi
items.summary: Negotiators from Ukraine, Russia and the United States are set to meet in the capital of the United Arab Emirates (UAE) on Tuesday for a new round of talks aimed at ending nearly five years of full-scale war triggered by Moscow's invasion of its neighbour. Security guarantees for the warring sides are set to top the agenda, with US officials insisting that a broader security architecture for Europe must be part of any peace deal.
